◆ Two ways to play

One studio, two games. Each mints a different kind of data.

Pick your energy: a quick two-player rally, or a full live scene with a castmate and an editor. Both pay, and each produces exactly what a different kind of lab needs.

Async · 2 playersASR · transcription

Ping-Pong

Prompts come in English. You say each one out loud in the target language, and your partner rates that translation 1 to 5 on tone, prompt, mood, and clarity. Score below 4 and you say it again, so every clip is verified before it ships.

English prompt · partner"Please confirm your account number."
Your Pidgin take · voice note🎙 "Abeg, confirm your account number."
tone · prompt · mood · clarity★★★★★
  • Turn-based and async, play anytime on a phone
  • You render English prompts in your language, out loud
  • Peer rating on 4 axes; below 4 means a redo
  • Produces clean, isolated single-speaker turns
Live Arena · 3 playersvoice-to-voice · customer care

Roleplay Arena

Two players hold a flowing, natural conversation, a customer complaint, a market haggle, a support call, while a third player rides along and corrects the transcript live. The result is rich, overlapping, emotional dual-channel audio, the kind voice agents are starved for.

◆ Inside the Live Arena

Three mechanics that make the flowing 3-player game sing.

These power the Live Arena, the roleplay game. (Async Ping-Pong is simpler: say the English prompt in your language, rate your partner, repeat.) We didn't gamify a chore; we built a game that happens to produce the world's most valuable voice data.

Mechanic 01
🎭

Blind Duet

You never know who your scene partner is, no names, no photos. It adds theatrical mystique, and it means no one can rig a scene. You're always paired with a stranger.

fun + fraud-proof pairing
Mechanic 02
⚡

The Twist

Mid-scene, a curveball drops for both of you, "reject the first apology," "switch to Pidgin now." It's the spike that keeps scenes unpredictable and makes the speech gloriously real.

fun + unscripted, natural audio
Mechanic 03
✦

Chemistry

A live meter fills as your scene flows naturally. High Chemistry means a bigger payout and a shared Standing Ovation. Instant dopamine, and a real quality score on your take.

fun + live quality signal

◆ From scene to shipped dataset

Watch a scene become the exact row a lab pays for.

Two steps, live-verified and machine-packaged. This is what makes Accent Studio a foundry, not a crowdsourcing app.

Step 2 · The Cutting Room

The third player verifies

A vetted native speaker listens in, fixes slang and Pidgin the STT misheard, tags emotion, timing and code-switches. Their work is silently sampled by trusted auditors so quality stays honest.

◆ Enterprise-grade delivery

Built to slot into your training pipeline on day one.

🔐

Air-gapped identity

PII in an isolated encrypted DB. Audio indexed only by cryptographic UUIDs. Zero identifiable user metrics shipped.

🛡

SOC 2 · WORM vault

AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit. Primary audio in Write-Once-Read-Many storage. SOC 2 Type II trust principles.

☁️

Direct S3 & Clean Rooms

Presigned S3/GCS URLs, direct IAM bucket sync, AWS Clean Rooms and Snowflake Data Clean Rooms for enterprise tiers.

🧠

HF · PyTorch native

WAV/FLAC + metadata.jsonl / metadata.parquet compatible with Hugging Face Datasets and PyTorch training loops out of the box.

◆ Clean by design

No real names. No account numbers. No privacy risk.

Every scene is fictional. The app supplies fake names and numbers, and automated scanners redact any strays before storage. Voice is treated as biometric data and decoupled from identity, so datasets are commercially clean the moment they're made.

GDPR aligned POPIA aligned NDPA 2023 Zero-PII by design Biometric decoupling
◆ Questions

Good to know

How do I actually get paid? +

Base rate is $7.20–$30 per verified hour, scaled by peer-QA multiplier (Platinum 1.2× · Gold 1.0× · Silver 0.7×). Cash out to Paystack & Flutterwave (West Africa, $5 min), M-Pesa (East Africa, $5 min), Stripe Connect & PayPal (UK/EU/US, $10 min), or USDC/USDT on Solana/Polygon ($2 min). Rewards clear after your scene passes verification.

Do I need a good microphone or fast internet? +

A normal phone and a decent connection are enough for async Volley (voice notes). The live Arena works best on a stable connection, but you can play the async mode anytime, anywhere.

Who do I play with? +

Always an anonymous stranger, never someone you know. It keeps scenes fair and your identity private. You're matched by language, dialect and rank.

What data is collected about me? +

Your voice, decoupled from your real identity behind a random ID. Scenes are fictional, so no personal details end up in the data. You consent before playing and can withdraw.

I'm a lab, how do I license a corpus? +

Request a sample below. We'll scope a corpus by dialect, domain and format, share a sample, then license non-exclusively, exclusively, or build a bespoke set for your use case.
